description.text: The second Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle, out on 1 September 2023 to start Pokéween, The Pokémon Company International's name for its Halloween season. That year it reached the UK for the first time, besides the US, Canada and Australia. A bundle held 50 mini packs of three cards. Its 30 cards are reprints from eight expansions, Sword & Shield to Paldea Evolved, which made it the first Trick or Trade set with Scarlet & Violet cards. Each keeps its number and has the Pikachu jack-o'-lantern stamped on the bottom right of its picture. Ten are holo: Trevenant, Chandelure, Gengar, Spectrier, Dusknoir, Marshadow, Houndoom, Houndstone, Pikachu and Mimikyu.
